svg.title: 9 - (8 - (7 - (6 - (5 - (4 - (3 - 2)))))): six registers fill, then the stack takes the rest
svg.text: the spare, never on the stack
Each spill moves sp down 16, not 8:
the calling convention keeps sp a

g.title: Six li: 9, 8, 7, 6, 5 and 4 fill t0 to t5, each the left operand of a subtraction still waiting for its right side. There is no register left for 3.
addi sp, sp, -16: room on the stack. sp moves down to 0x80010030. The left operand in t5 has to go there, so t5 can take the right side.
sd t5, 0(sp): 4 is stored in memory at sp. t5 is free for the right operand.
li t5, 3: the right operand goes into t5, the same register, at the same depth.
addi sp, sp, -16: room on the stack. sp moves down to 0x80010020. Inside the right side, the same again: t5 is the last register.
sd t5, 0(sp): 3 is stored in memory at sp. t5 is free for the right operand.
li t5, 2: the right operand goes into t5, the same register, at the same depth. It is the deepest leaf: the stack has two values.
ld t6, 0(sp): the waiting value, 3, comes back from memory into t6, the spare.
addi sp, sp, 16: the room is given back; sp is 0x80010030 again.
sub t5, t6, t5: t6 (the left operand) minus t5 (the right) is 1, into t5. t6 is free.
ld t6, 0(sp): the waiting value, 4, comes back from memory into t6, the spare.
addi sp, sp, 16: the room is given back; sp is 0x80010040 again, where it started.
sub t5, t6, t5: t6 (the left operand) minus t5 (the right) is 3, into t5. t6 is free.
sub t4, t4, t5: 2 into t4; t5 is free. The stack of registers unwinds.
sub t3, t3, t4: 4 into t3; t4 is free. The stack of registers unwinds.
sub t2, t2, t3: 3 into t2; t3 is free. The stack of registers unwinds.
sub t1, t1, t2: 5 into t1; t2 is free. The stack of registers unwinds.
sub t0, t0, t1: 4 into t0; t1 is free. The stack of registers unwinds.
